headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 28, 2026**
article:
The Washington Nationals secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge at the plate. García Jr. went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. In other action, the Texas Rangers edged the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes hitting a crucial home run, and the Houston Astros took down the Detroit Tigers 7-5.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their team's availability. Roman Anthony has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Boston Red Sox. The Texas Rangers placed Wyatt Langford on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The Cincinnati Reds placed Blake Dunn on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 27, 2026, due to a right elbow sprain. Other teams have also made injury-related moves, including the Chicago Cubs, Toronto Blue Jays, San Francisco Giants, and Boston Red Sox.

The Seattle Mariners bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded right-hander Hayden Juenger to the Athletics for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs acquired left-hander David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 6-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a hard-fought win against the Baltimore Orioles, with Luis García Jr. leading the charge at the plate. García Jr. went 3 for 5 with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs, propelling the Nationals to a 6-4 final score.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Pirates in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 9-4 defeat at the hands of the Pittsburgh Pirates. Ryan O'Hearn led the Reds' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers took down the Toronto Blue Jays 3-2, with Nathan Lukes leading the charge at the plate. Lukes hit a crucial home run, his fourth of the season, to help secure the win.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 7-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers in their matchup. Isaac Paredes led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, while Jack Flaherty pitched 5 strong innings for the Astros, striking out 9 batters with 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Roman Anthony Shifts to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox left fielder Roman Anthony has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list, marking a significant change in his status. This move indicates a longer recovery period for the player.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that shakes up the team's lineup.
